data.one_liner: A Dart/Flutter library for building LLM‑powered applications with LangChain patterns.
data.what_it_does: Provides unified APIs for LLM providers, retrieval, agents, and chaining components. Includes core abstractions and higher‑level chains to simplify building chatbots, RAG, and other generative AI use cases.
use_when: You need to integrate multiple LLM providers in a Flutter app
You want a composable, chain‑based architecture for AI features
You require retrieval‑augmented generation or agent tooling
avoid_when: You only need a single, lightweight LLM client without extra abstractions
You prefer a minimal pure‑http wrapper instead of a full framework
strengths: Modular design lets you import only needed parts
Supports many providers and retrieval/agent patterns
weaknesses: Adds a learning curve compared to simple HTTP clients
Potentially larger bundle size for full feature set
Breaking changes between major versions may require migration
data.setup_notes: Add the package to pubspec.yaml; optionally include integration packages (e.g., langchain_openai). No special permissions required beyond network access.

alternatives.name: llamadart
alternatives.why_pick_it: A lightweight Dart client for LLaMA models, suitable if you only need a single LLM backend

alternatives.name: firebase_ai
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides Firebase‑hosted AI services with tighter integration to other Firebase features

alternatives.name: gpt_markdown
alternatives.why_pick_it: Simpler wrapper focused on OpenAI GPT and markdown generation, less overhead than full LangChain
